description: Connect your domain to your Heat Engineer website. Existing website routing records for this address will be replaced.
variableDescription: Website values are supplied and signed by Heat Engineer. cnamePrefix and cnameSuffix reconstruct the exact Vercel target; cnameSuffix is empty or a hyphen followed by digits. verificationHostSuffix1 and verificationHostSuffix2 are empty or a dot followed by relative DNS labels below _vercel. verificationToken1 and verificationToken2 contain the challenge after vc-domain-verify=. Do not pass host. sub is the non-empty website subdomain relative to the domain.
